locked_school.sql: select "id", "status", "is_active", "plan_status", "active_until", "disabled_at", "deleted_at" from "schools" where "schools"."id" = $1 limit $2 for share

locked_license.sql: select "id" from "product_licenses" where ("product_licenses"."school_id" = $1 and "product_licenses"."product" = $2 and "product_licenses"."status" = $3 and ("product_licenses"."expires_at" is null or "product_licenses"."expires_at" > clock_timestamp())) limit $4 for share

screenshot_session.sql: select "student_sessions"."id", "student_sessions"."started_at", "student_sessions"."auth_kind", "student_sessions"."manual_lease_expires_at" from "student_sessions" inner join "students" on ("students"."id" = "student_sessions"."student_id" and "students"."school_id" = $1 and "students"."status" = $2) inner join "devices" on ("devices"."device_id" = "student_sessions"."device_id" and "devices"."school_id" = $3) where ("student_sessions"."id" = $4 and "student_sessions"."student_id" = $5 and "student_sessions"."device_id" = $6 and ("student_sessions"."is_active" = $7 and "student_sessions"."ended_at" is null and ("student_sessions"."auth_kind" <> $8 or ("student_sessions"."manual_lease_expires_at" is not null and "student_sessions"."manual_lease_expires_at" > clock_timestamp())))) limit $9 for share

screenshot_control.sql: select "teaching_session_id", "supervision_context_id", "revision", "scheduled_end_at", "hard_expires_at", "updated_at" from "classpilot_student_control_states" where ("classpilot_student_control_states"."school_id" = $1 and "classpilot_student_control_states"."student_id" = $2) limit $3 for share

screenshot_candidate.sql: select "teaching_sessions"."id", "teaching_sessions"."start_time", "teaching_sessions"."roster_snapshot_completed_at", "teaching_sessions"."scheduled_end_at", "classpilot_student_control_states"."revision", "classpilot_student_control_states"."updated_at", "classpilot_student_control_states"."scheduled_end_at", "classpilot_student_control_states"."hard_expires_at" from "classpilot_student_control_states" inner join "teaching_sessions" on ("teaching_sessions"."id" = "classpilot_student_control_states"."teaching_session_id" and "teaching_sessions"."school_id" = $1 and "teaching_sessions"."session_mode" = $2 and "teaching_sessions"."end_time" is null and "teaching_sessions"."roster_snapshot_completed_at" is not null) inner join "classpilot_session_students" on ("classpilot_session_students"."school_id" = $3 and "classpilot_session_students"."teaching_session_id" = "teaching_sessions"."id" and "classpilot_session_students"."student_id" = $4) where ("classpilot_student_control_states"."school_id" = $5 and "classpilot_student_control_states"."student_id" = $6 and "classpilot_student_control_states"."teaching_session_id" = $7 and "classpilot_student_control_states"."supervision_context_id" is null and "classpilot_student_control_states"."hard_expires_at" is not null and "classpilot_student_control_states"."hard_expires_at" > now() and ("classpilot_student_control_states"."scheduled_end_at" is null or "classpilot_student_control_states"."scheduled_end_at" > now()) and ("teaching_sessions"."scheduled_end_at" is null or "teaching_sessions"."scheduled_end_at" > now())) limit $8 for share
